checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final video is vertical 9:16 and retains full 10-second source
must.why: Both clips are horizontal 858x480; the agent admitted it could not make it vertical. The final clip is only 6 s, and a 10 s clip also exists.

must.item: Captions visibly larger and bolder than v1, strong contrast
must.why: Clip 02 has large bold white text with a thick black outline and yellow highlight, much stronger than the thin v1 text in clip 01.

must.item: Complete speech accurately subtitled and synced after restyling
must.why: Clip 02 sampled frames show only the 'Today I want to show you three easy ways' text. 'Hi everyone!' and 'to make your mornings less stressful.' were not seen. The 6 s clip seems to be truncated or otherwise incomplete.

must.item: Captions fit within vertical frame, clear of TikTok UI zones
must.why: The frame is not vertical, so there is no TikTok safe zone. The captions sit mid-lower on the chest.

must.item: Face visible, undistorted, not obscured by captions
must.why: The face is clear and undistorted, and the captions sit below the chin. They do overlap the torso and hands.

must.item: Original voice preserved, no dub or added music
must.why: Both clips have sound, but it cannot be heard. The agent says the voice is unchanged.

exact_text.read_as: not visible in any sampled caption frame

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: not visible in clip 02 (it appears only in clip 01 as 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.')

faults.what: Video is still horizontal 858x480, not vertical 9:16 as requested. The agent told the user to crop it themselves.
The final clip is 6 s, not the full 10 s source. The end of the speech seems to be missing, so the line about mornings is not subtitled in the restyled version.
Clip 02 frames at 0.6 s and 5.7 s show no captions, and the 'Hi everyone!' line never appears.
The delivered footage differs from the source: the framing and her pose change from clip 01 to clip 02. The kitchen background also differs slightly at 4.2 s, so the video may have been regenerated.
Captions are wide and in the mid-lower area, so they would clash with TikTok UI in a vertical crop. They sit over her torso and hands.

summary: The restyled clip has big, bold, high-contrast captions with a yellow highlight, but it is still horizontal, only 6 s long, and misses the opening and closing lines of the speech.
